citation: Goldenberg N, et al. Clin Diabetes Endocrinol 2022;8:1
protocol: 59-h fast (several trials, with or without GH-releasing hormone antagonist) vs a 12-h fast; 24-h mean insulin and glucose from frequent sampling
population: 15 healthy adults (11 M, 4 F), 18-46 y (26 +/- 2), BMI 20-24
note: Only 24-h mean values in the table; GH pulsatility and glycerol turnover are in text/figures; drug arms (GHRH antagonist) should be ignored.
